end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names with Krish, including “cow” and “rooster.” Krish identified “rooster” at the end, but the difference between an animal’s name and its sound needs more practice. At home, you can point to a farm-animal picture and ask, “What is its English name?” then separately ask, “What sound does it make?” Krish also said, “Sometimes I feel it would be better if I weren’t here”; please check in with them calmly and seek immediate support if they may be in danger.
